title: Petra and the Autopsy
author: Mara Dravenmoor
blurb: Yara Amberdale, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
